items.headline: Patience starting to run thin for head coaches in Week 11

items.headline: Bear Bachmeier runs for three TDs, throws for another to lead No. 12 BYU past Baylor, 28-7
items.description: — Bear Bachmeier ran for three touchdowns and threw for another score to lead No. 12 BYU to a 28-7 victory over Baylor on Saturday night.

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

items.headline: Sources: Robert Griffin III expected to interview for Baylor job
items.description: Heisman Trophy winner Robert Griffin III is expected to interview for the head coaching job at his alma mater, Baylor, sources told ESPN.
